meta.subject: Boating operator certificates (New York, Connecticut, California, Ontario/BC via Canada's PCOC, England, Ireland, Mexico) and the private pilot certificate (FAA, Transport Canada, UK CAA, IAA, AFAC): what the law asks, the course, the exam, retakes, prices and published pass rates.
meta.why: SLATE now issues a boating certificate at once on payment (src/engine/content/boats.ts BOAT_RULES[*].certificate: NY $15, CT $50, CA $10, ON C$49.95) and a pilot's knowledge test and checkride always pass (src/engine/systems/aviation.ts PILOT_TRAINING knowledgeTest 175, checkride 1,000). These figures are for building the course, the exam that can be failed, the retake rule and its wait.
meta.conventions: confirmed=true only when the figure was read on 2026-10-02 from the authority's or the provider's own page or PDF (fetched directly, or fetched with curl and read with pdftotext). confirmed=false means it came from a search engine's summary, a secondary site, or a page that refused the fetch. sourceType is 'primary' for the authority or the provider itself, else 'secondary'. Nothing is invented: where nothing was found the value is null with a note.

boating.credential: New York Boating Safety Certificate (Brianna's Law)

law.who: Every operator of a motorized vessel, including personal watercraft and specialty craft, must have completed a state-approved safe boating course.

sources.note: All operators of motorized vessels; at least 10 to attend; certificates good for life; temporary certificate valid 90 days.
Phase-in dates by birth date as listed by the BoatUS Foundation, an approved provider.

course.note: Classroom course is at least 8 hours (NYS Parks). Online courses are offered by approved providers; the BoatUS Foundation course has a 60-question final.

exam.questionsNote: The OPRHP classroom final's length isn't stated in the instructor guide. BoatUS's online final is 60 questions (boatus.org/newyork, confirmed).
exam.quote: This is a "closed book" examination and the required minimum passing score is 76%.

retakes.note: No retake rule found in NYS Parks pages or the instructor guide.

prices.item: Permanent certificate, classroom route, age 18 or older
prices.note: "OPRHP collects a $10.00 fee for issuance of the permanent boating safety certificate to anyone age eighteen or older"; under 18 pays nothing to OPRHP. Volunteer instructors charge no fee; commercial instructors set their own.
The only free online course New York approves; a free 90-day temporary certificate is printable.

boating.credential: Certificado de Competencia como Patrón de Embarcaciones de Recreo y Deportivas, niveles I y II (SEMAR, Dirección General de Marina Mercante)

law.who: Whoever commands a recreational and sports vessel must carry a current certificate of the level its length asks: level I to 6 m length, level II to 15 m, level III above.
requirements: Approved STCW-updated training course at a DGMM-authorized institution
Psychophysical fitness certificate from the Unidad de Protección y Medicina Preventiva en el Transporte, no older than two years

requirements.credential: Private Pilot Certificate, airplane single-engine land
requirements.detail: 3 hours cross-country training, 3 night (one flight over 100 nm, 10 full-stop landings), 3 on instruments, 3 of test preparation within 2 calendar months; 5 hours solo cross-country with one 150 nm flight of three full-stop landings.

sources.note: 14 CFR 61.109(a); the eCFR redirected to a bot check.

requirements.detail: Dual includes 3 cross-country and 5 instrument; solo includes 5 cross-country.
requirements.note: Hours from a search summary of CARs Standard 421. Brampton Flight Centre's own page confirms 'a minimum of 45 hours'.

requirements.detail: 10 hours supervised solo, at least 5 solo cross-country with one of at least 270 km (150 nm). Part-MED Class 2 medical. Theory passes valid 24 months for the licence application.
requirements.note: The CAA page says 40 hours of instruction (35 at an approved training organisation); schools and SLATE's earlier research use 45, the EASA figure Ireland keeps. A CAA consultation (CAP 3094) proposes aligning to ICAO.

requirements.detail: National Flight Centre, Weston: 45 hours with an instructor, 18 hours of briefings, 9 IAA theory exams, ELP check, Class 2 medical; 9 to 12 months.
requirements.note: 45 hours confirmed on NFC's page; the 25 dual / 10 solo split is from a search summary (Part-FCL FCL.210.A).

requirements.credential: Licencia de Piloto Privado de Ala Fija
requirements.detail: 5 hours cross-country incl. a route of at least 270 km (150 nm) with two landings at different points; 5 hours certified within two months before applying; approved course certificate within two months; restricted aeronautical radiotelephone course; theory-practical exams set by the authority; psychophysical fitness certificate.
requirements.nationality: The requisites ask for 'documento con el que acredite ser mexicano por nacimiento' (Mexican by birth).

knowledgeTest.feeQuote: The Federal Aviation Administration and PSI have established all aviation exam fees at $175
knowledgeTest.retake: No waiting period; the applicant needs training from an authorized instructor and that instructor's endorsement (14 CFR 61.49). Each attempt pays the fee again.

knowledgeTest.passRule: 60% overall and 60% in each of Air Law, Navigation, Meteorology and Aeronautics General Knowledge; under 60% overall rewrites the whole exam, a failed subject alone is rewritten as its supplement (CARs 421.26).

rewriteWait.thirdAndLater: 30 days plus 30 for each failure beyond two, up to 180

knowledgeTest.feeNote: CARs Schedule IV item 1: $105 when written before a Transport Canada employee, $65 (item 2) before another person. Transport Canada indexes fees to inflation every 1 April; a search summary gave $131.54 for the PPL exam now (unconfirmed).

knowledgeTest.test: UK CAA PPL(A) theoretical knowledge, nine papers

worthChecking: SLATE's US-CT certificate basis ('$50 after an approved course') is borne out; the course itself is 8 hours instructor-led with a proctored 80% exam, and an experienced boater may instead sit a $75 once-only equivalency exam.

SLATE's CA-ON PCOC basis marks BOATsmart!'s C$49.95 as secondary; it is on BOATsmart!'s own page (confirmed here), and it includes unlimited retests. Cheaper approved providers exist (freecourse.ca C$29.95).

The PCOC retest wait (24 hours, one retest within 30 days, then the course again) and the PPAER rewrite waits (14, 30, then +30 per failure to 180 days) are the two published waiting periods a failed-exam mechanic can use; the FAA has none, only an instructor's endorsement after more training.
AFAC's private pilot licence requisites ask for proof of being Mexican by birth; a foreign resident in Mexico may not be able to get one, which SLATE's PILOT_SCHOOLS.mx doesn't model.

SEMAR's patrón certificate requires 24 months of sea time as a marinero turístico and is written for crew who work aboard; it reads as a professional credential, not a private boater's card. Check the Reglamento de la Ley de Navegación y Comercio Marítimos (arts. 150-173) before modelling a Mexican boat certificate.
The UK CAA PPL page says 40 hours of instruction (35 at an approved organisation), not the 45 that schools and SLATE's earlier research use.
Hotel Bravo's 2026 rate (€145 an hour, search summary) disagrees with the €175/€160 SLATE keeps; re-read the club's page when its certificate is renewed.

Transport Canada's CARs Schedule IV fees ($105 exam, $200 flight test, $55 licence, $55 medical processing) are pre-indexation; TC indexes every 1 April, and a search summary gave $131.54 for the PPL exam now.
The IAA licence issue fee is €320 (Schedule 4, effective 1 January 2026), and theory exams are €29 a subject; search summaries quoting €460 and €130 are wrong for 2026.
